items.prompt: Ledger a{37}, b{37}; both basic(true) and strong(true) are called in separate try/catch blocks. After both runtime_errors are caught, which pair (a.cents,b.cents) remains?

options.why: basic changes cents to 0 before it throws, so it does not preserve the original value.
basic mutates valid state before failure; strong throws during preparation before its scalar commit.
strong only assigns 20 after the failure injection point; that assignment is not reached.
The success assignments are not reached on either injected-failure path.
